name: vLLM per-request time-per-output-token (TPOT) histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: inter_token_latency (shared ladder). One sample per finished request, so it is the right basis for a per-user TPOT SLO where inter_token_latency is the right basis for a fleet stall detector.
